summary: This paper presents RPS-KNN, an FPGA accelerator for K-nearest-neighbor search in LiDAR odometry, implemented using Xilinx Vitis HLS. No code availability statement appears in the paper — there is no 'our code is available at' sentence, no GitHub link, no footnote URL, and no project page. Searches across GitHub (repo names, READMEs, code contents), the first author's (xiaojzh) and co-authors' repositories, and the ECASLab organization yielded no repository matching this paper. I am confident the authors have not publicly released their code for this paper.
